title: Hook
text: Aquarium staff know the octopus as an escape artist.
nxt: There are many accounts of octopuses leaving their tanks at night, crossing wet floors to reach other tanks, and returning home before morning.

title: Lamp Prank
text: Octopuses also seem to learn from cause and effect. At the Sea Star Aquarium in Coburg, Germany,
nxt: an octopus named Otto reportedly squirted a jet of water at a bright lamp above his tank, apparently to switch it off.

title: Jar Puzzle
text: In laboratory studies, octopuses have solved a number of puzzles.
nxt: An octopus given a crab inside a clear jar with a screw lid has been reported to learn how to unscrew the lid.

title: Faces
text: Octopuses can even tell individual humans apart.
nxt: At the Seattle Aquarium, researchers worked with eight giant Pacific octopuses and two people in the same T-shirt.
